mfa.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
mfa.enrolIntro: Your account needs two-factor sign-in. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.secretLabel: Or enter this key in the app by hand:
mfa.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
mfa.saved: I have saved my recovery codes
mfa.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be verified.
mfa.passkeyOr: Or set up a passkey instead, with this device or a security key:

security.title: Two-factor sign-in
security.signInIntro: Sign in again to manage how you confirm your sign-ins.
security.signedInAs: Signed in as {email} for the next 10 minutes.
security.required: Your account must keep at least one second factor.
security.codesNeedMethod: Set up an authenticator app or a passkey first.
security.lastMethod: Your account must keep a second factor: set up another one before removing this one.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your e-mail and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.invalid: This link has expired or was already used.
setPassword.tooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters.

error.title: Sign-in problem
error.expired: This link has expired. Please try again.
error.noPassword: Set your password first, through the link you were sent, then sign in.
error.domain: Your e-mail domain is not allowed to sign in here.
error.unverifiedEmail: Your identity provider has not verified this e-mail address.
error.issuer: This sign-in was issued by the wrong identity provider.
error.audience: This sign-in was issued for a different application.
error.signature: This sign-in could not be verified.
error.nonce: This sign-in could not be verified.
error.generic: Something went wrong while signing in.
error.unavailable: This page could not be shown.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.uploaded: The file was uploaded. You can close this page.
upload.expired: This upload link has expired. Ask for a new one.
upload.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to upload this file.
upload.invalid: Only WAV and MP3 files can be uploaded.
upload.failed: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again.
upload.error: The file could not be uploaded. An upload is a WAV or MP3 file of at most 50 MB.
